reports.title: Valvoline Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Outlook
section: “Looking ahead to fiscal 2027, we expect another year of strong growth,” Flees added. "Our outlook assumes no change in the supply environment — stable availability and continued elevated product costs. Our team will keep executing with discipline, staying focused on serving our customers, growing our network and managing costs. We remain confident in the underlying strength of our business and the long-term value we can create for shareholders.”
Information regarding the Company’s outlook for fiscal 2027 is provided in the table below:

System-wide SSS growth1 | 5.0% - 7.0%
System-wide store additions1 | 190 - 220
Net revenues | $2.25 - $2.35 billion
Adjusted EBITDA1 | $595 - $625 million
Adjusted EPS1 | $1.85 - $2.05
Capital expenditures | $245 - $265 million
